id_and_class.summary: Jakob Lorber, a 19th-century Christian mystic writing from what he took to be revelations from Christ, holds that a human being is a soul and a divine spirit briefly incarnated together in a material body. The soul is built from countless living intelligence particles called specifica, while the spirit is a spark of God’s love placed in the soul’s heart around birth and heavily shielded so it does not overpower the soul. The purpose of life is to unite soul and spirit through seeking God and selfless love.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as Soul Particles Guided by a Divine Spark

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness rests on specifica, intangible living intelligence particles that are the most basic constituents of both the spiritual and physical world, raised in humans by an indwelling divine spirit.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Soul and spirit are incarnated in a material body for a very short time. Specifica can be bound in matter, and their combinations account for the many shapes of matter in nature.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (specifica are fundamental living intelligence particles; higher intelligence arises as they combine into larger clusters)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Humans have a dual intelligence and will: that of the soul (mind) and that of the spirit (heart). The spirit is experienced as the soft voice of conscience.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: God; specifica (free-roaming or bound in matter); higher-level guiding spirits; individual souls; a divine spirit spark in each human; the material body.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Revelation received as an inner voice, which Lorber believed was Jesus Christ’s, together with conscience.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: The soul is an uncountable cluster of specifica. The divine spirit sits in the soul’s heart inside a seven-fold encapsulation that lets a small amount of spiritual light through.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Intelligence; Free will; Conscience and morality; Spiritual development
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: A shielded divine spark leaks a small amount of spiritual light into the soul, giving it free will and raising the intelligence of its specifica well above that of animal souls.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Specifica keep combining into higher intelligence clusters and, guided by higher spirits, work their way up through the mineral, plant, and animal kingdoms to the level of a human soul. The divine spirit is placed a few days before or after birth.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Specifica pervade the spiritual and physical world. The divine spirit resides in the heart of the soul.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: The spirit gives the soul a basic sense of morality, while its god-like power also stirs selfishness and arrogance that the soul must notice and resist.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Specifica unify with one another to form ever higher intelligence clusters.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: Souls ascend through mineral, plant, and animal forms before reaching the human level; human and animal soul particles are of the same nature, with the divine spirit making the difference.
core_claims_and_evidence: A human being is a soul and a divine spirit briefly incarnated in a material body.
The soul consists of countless specifica, the most basic particles of the spiritual and physical world.
The divine spirit is encapsulated seven-fold so it does not overpower the soul’s developing free will.
Incarnation separates soul and spirit from God’s almightiness so the soul can freely seek and love its Creator.

empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Consistent within its Christian-mystical framework, though specifica are said to be intangible yet also the most basic particles of the physical world, and the account of how they compose matter is not developed.

AI_consciousness.rationale: Human consciousness depends on a soul of specifica and a divine spirit placed by God, which no artifact could supply.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Soul and spirit are incarnated in the body only for a very short time, so they continue after it.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Lorber holds that God created humanity out of love so that it would love him in return and love others more than oneself.

virtual_immortality.rationale: Since the person is a soul and divine spirit, a digital copy of the body or brain would not carry them.
